items.title: Paisley Swirl Droplet DXF Screen for Artistic Wall Panels
items.description: Teardrop shapes spiral outward from curling paisley centers, scattering across the panel in a loose, painterly rhythm. The organic swirl motion suits artistic feature walls, boutique storefronts, and screens with a bohemian feel.

items.title: Moroccan Star Mosaic DXF Design for Laser-Cut Doors
items.description: An eight-point star and cross motif repeats edge to edge in the style of classic Andalusian zellige tilework. Every star locks into its neighbors through short interlocking arms, giving the panel real structural rigidity.
